I have farmed in Amhara for many years, and I know this quarter-hectare rice plot well. I will spread manure from my animals and a small amount of urea from the cooperative, but I will plant my own saved seed and pull the weeds by hand. My children and I will do all the work ourselves since the plot is small, and I will wait for the rains because there is no pump or canal here.
